About Us
Chippewa Valley Ethanol Company (CVEC) in Benson, Minnesota operates in the heart of Swift County. Our fertile farmland and rich growing conditions are home to some of the most dedicated corn producers and production facilities in the region.

Products
Ethanol is a renewable fuel alternative to gasoline that is produced with a lower carbon footprint than traditional fossil fuels. During the production of ethanol, additional byproducts are created, such as distillers grains and solubles. To maximize the efficiency of our process and support other markets, these co-products enter the biodiesel industry and animal feed that provides a valuable source of protein and nutrients.
CVEC exists to serve our cooperative members with corn receiving, cash bids, futures and scale house services. We also offer E85 and ethanol production byproducts such as distiller’s grains, syrup and corn oil. Most importantly, we expand markets for our members and aim to impact our surrounding communities and environment in positive ways
